record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, tie the output embedding weight to the input embedding weight while retaining unit normalization, width=128 and zero padding. Shared item representations may improve statistical efficiency for sparse items and remove disagreement between independently trained input and candidate vectors. Preserve the GRU, popularity-change input scaling, history policy, readout, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer. Update model construction and predictor loading so each category restores one consistently tied checkpoint.

category_rationales.rationale: Tie input and output item embeddings across all four category models to improve statistical efficiency while preserving unit normalization, embedding width and zero padding. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so checkpoint loading restores the tied architecture consistently. GRU, features, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.
